singleItemEdit.workload: Select Rectangle 100000, then three ArrowRight edits; wall time includes reading X, dispatching the key, observing changed X and completed autosave. CDP CPU profiler enabled in both runs. Automation overhead included; not input-to-display latency.

alignmentRepro.workload: Flat 400-column rectangle grid, all nodes selected, align left; reducer only; cold invocation per size. Before throws if over 250 ms.

bulkBrowser.workload: Select all, align left, wait for completed save, verify every stored X, undo, wait for completed save, verify the entire original scene. Timings exclude full-document verification and include Playwright action overhead. No CPU profiler.
bulkBrowser.note: Undo baseline already includes alignment, renderer and journal changes. The baseline run failed its 5-second undo budget. No successful original 100k browser alignment baseline was recorded.

cpu100k.workload: One cold operation per command; no browser/GPU; correctness assertions plus a machine-dependent 2-second guard per operation

limitations: Three single-edit samples and one bulk run are diagnostic, not a broad latency distribution.
The hang was reproduced through slow reducers and bulk undo; no browser crash dump was captured. The final 100k browser alignment and undo complete without a crash.
Bulk edits still synchronize and save many nodes; about half a second is not a frame-time guarantee.
The marquee runner is capped near 60 Hz and does not establish 120 Hz performance.
Concurrent editing of one saved document in multiple tabs remains unsupported.
